acceptance_criteria.criterion: One focused local lane; one canonical hosted full proof per immutable head except trusted-definition changes; parallel independent checks; per-stage deadlines and bounded reviewer retry/timeout; unavailable reviewers nonblocking while substantive findings remain blocking.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing proof-reuse, parallel-lane, terminal-state and finding-block regressions pass. Reviewer collector old 52-minute envelope reduced to 38 minutes around the current 1920-second active-pool hard bound. 500 focused tests, Defect Prevention Guard and Ruff pass.

defect_families.evidence: M6 only tightens the bounded reviewer execution envelope and regression guard; canonical proof/reuse/fail-closed authorities are unchanged. 500 focused tests pass.
